regime.summary: Policy rate held at 11.5% on 2026-06-15, but CPI has jumped from 7.29% to 11.08% in three months, so the real policy rate is about zero and the next move is likelier up than down. The T-bill sits at policy, so the curve prices no move. Index is -2.5% over 1m but +29% over 12m. Neutral: no timing signal, core rests on business questions.

core.thesis: Screen shows a large earnings jump and a low multiple, 7.5% below its 252-day high. Business questions (builder culture, sponsor record, reinvestment returns) are not answerable from this pack, so weight is moderate and rests on growth plus cheapness only.

Islamic bank sector is the one rate-resilient, positively trending group (3m +19.8%, 6m +1.2%), and MEBL is 4.6% below its high with 12m +60%. EPS growth is flat, so this is a quality resting place, not a growth bet. Insiders filed repeatedly in July.

Earnings up 54% year on year, P/E near 6, price up 60% over 3m and 8% under its high with an upper lock. Extended after a run, so held smaller; a board meeting was noticed on 2026-06-29. Business and sponsor quality unknown from the pack.
